rows.Title: FAQ 1
rows.Question: After the dial-in functionality has been enabled in Teams, is it still possible to use Skype audio conferencing?
rows.Answer: Yes, existing Skype audio conferencing keeps working until the upgrade completes.

rows.Title: FAQ 2
rows.Question: Can external parties call in Teams meetings using the phone number in the invite?
rows.Answer: Yes, anyone with the dial-in number and conference ID can join by phone.

rows.Title: FAQ 3
rows.Question: Can I still use Skype for Business after being upgraded?
rows.Answer: No, after the upgrade to Teams only mode Skype for Business is disabled.

rows.Title: FAQ 4
rows.Question: Check audio and video before meeting in Teams and Skype
rows.Answer: Use the device settings test call to check your microphone and camera before joining.

rows.Title: FAQ 5
rows.Question: Create list of participants from Teams meeting
rows.Answer:
There is no easy way to get a list of participants from a normal Teams meeting.

It is in theMicrosoft Uservoice wishlist

One workaround is to copy the participants from the chat:Open the chat (which you find if you go the meeting in the Teams calendar)Open the list of participants and copy all (Ctrl-A, then Ctrl -C)Paste the text into Word (Ctrl-V)Copy the part where the participants are listed (mark and Ctrl -C)Paste into Excel (Ctrl -V)Create a table (Ctrl-T)
(slightly related, i.e. how to get a list of memberos in a Teasm group, is shown in the beginning ofthis video).

rows.Title: FAQ 6
rows.Question: External users unable to access Microsoft Teams
rows.Answer: Check that guest access is enabled for the tenant and the team.

rows.Title: FAQ 7
rows.Question: How to use custom background image
rows.Answer: Choose background effects in the meeting toolbar and upload your own image.

rows.Title: FAQ 8
rows.Question: How to use Teams with ELX
rows.Answer: Install the ELX connector from the Teams app store and sign in with your work account.

rows.Title: FAQ 9
rows.Question: How to use the dial-in functionality in Teams meetings?
rows.Answer: Schedule the meeting in Outlook or Teams; the invite includes the dial-in number and conference ID.

rows.Title: FAQ 10
rows.Question: Is the dial in number in the Teams meeting invite toll-free?
rows.Answer: No, the default numbers are toll numbers; toll-free numbers require an add-on license.

rows.Title: FAQ 11
rows.Question: Is there a chat history like in skype? How long the chat history will stay? Will they be automatically deleted after some time?
rows.Answer: Teams keeps chat history indefinitely unless a retention policy deletes it.

rows.Title: FAQ 12
rows.Question: Is there a dial-out functionality in Teams?
rows.Answer: Yes, meeting organizers with audio conferencing can call out to phone numbers.

rows.Title: FAQ 13
rows.Question: Unable to add Dial-in numbers in Team meetings
rows.Answer: Verify the organizer has an audio conferencing license assigned.

rows.Title: FAQ 14
rows.Question: Unable to add Third party connectors in Microsoft Teams (Eg : Webhook, Polly, MindMeister etc )
rows.Answer: Third-party apps may be blocked by policy; ask your admin to allow them in the Teams admin center.

rows.Title: FAQ 15
rows.Question: What do I need to do?
rows.Answer: Nothing; the upgrade happens automatically and your meetings move to Teams.

rows.Title: FAQ 16
rows.Question: What happens with meeting invites that have been created in past after the Teams dial-in functionality has been enabled
rows.Answer: Existing invites keep their Skype details until the meetings are updated or recreated.
